subject: general
question: Among the following diseases, which one is NOT inherited?
solution:
The correct answer is **Malaria**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Down syndrome**, **Cystic fibrosis**, and **Muscular dystrophy** are genetic disorders passed from parents to children through genes.
 
• **Malaria** is caused by the Plasmodium parasites, which are transmitted to people through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes.
 
• Genetic disorders are inherited and are part of an individual's genetic makeup, whereas malaria is an infectious disease not determined by genetics.
 
• Understanding the difference between genetic and infectious diseases is crucial for diagnosis, treatment, and prevention strategies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Disease Type
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Genetic Disorders**
 Conditions caused by abnormalities in genes or chromosomes. Some may be inherited, while others occur due to mutations or changes in genes.
 
 

 **Infectious Diseases**
 Diseases caused by pathogenic microorganisms, such as bacteria, viruses, parasites, or fungi; can be spread, directly or indirectly, from one person to another.
 
 

 **Malaria**
 An infectious disease caused by Plasmodium parasites, transmitted to humans through the bite of infected Anopheles mosquitoes.
